purpose: Teach: 松岡/呉/伊東/藤沢/永井/尾崎/黒田/英寿

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがTOKIO松岡さんのリアルタイム番組を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is watching a live broadcast of TOKIO's Matsuoka.
lines.style: Warm and matter-of-fact, like sharing a household fact. Gentle, unrushed tone. A small smile in the voice without forcing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと広島県呉のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about Kure in Hiroshima with Dad.
lines.style: Bright and genuine excitement. Clean attack on the opening word. Eager to share, not performing—just honestly delighted. Quick pace, no pause between thoughts.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが伊東温泉のお土産を下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your father says he'll bring you back a souvenir from Ito Hot Spring.
lines.style: Warm and pleased. Measured pace. A small lift at the end—she's genuinely happy about this. Gentle, slightly indulgent tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと藤沢周平の時代劇観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a period drama by Fujisawa Shuhei with Dad.
lines.style: Genuine warmth and excitement. Slightly higher energy than before. Direct, unguarded. Quick delivery, the rush of wanting to share something good.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが永井荷風の文庫本を集めてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is collecting paperback editions of Nagai Kafu's works.
lines.style: Observing and slightly amused. Gentle delivery. A touch of wry affection—she notices and appreciates his interests. Unhurried, warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと尾崎豊さんの曲をカラオケで歌ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I sang Ozaki Yutaka songs with Dad at karaoke.
lines.style: Bright, genuine joy. Clean attack. Unguarded enthusiasm—he wants her to know he had fun. Slightly faster pace, the speed of sharing something good.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが黒田官兵衛の歴史本を読んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father is reading a history book about Kuroda Kanbe'i.
lines.style: Warm observation. Slightly slower pace, like she's noticing his concentration. Fond, gentle—she understands his interests. No edge, just quiet appreciation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと中田英寿選手の伝記読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a biography of Nakata Hidetoshi with Dad.
lines.style: Warm and content. A touch slower, more satisfied than the previous eagerness. Still genuine, but with a small sense of completion—something shared and done well together.
